notes.title: Big Update Koo & Yuu - New Mode
notes.content:
Hello guys, today we are releasing a big update for Koo & Yuu.
The package contains:
+ New free DLC, released after completing all previous phases.
+ 3 new color backgrounds.
+ 3 new hidden achievements.
And bug fixes reported by the community.

notes.title: Update 2: Achievements and more
notes.content:
New steam achievements for you. Best of all, you won't have to play the levels again to get the achievements that should already be gained.

And also some bug fixes in the last levels.

Thanks for playing and encouraging the creators of Koo & Yuu.

2020 will be a year of several other releases for you, our audience!

notes.title: Update 1: Bug fixes and Steam Cloud
notes.content:
[h2]Rendering and puzzle bugs resolved.
Steam cloud now available.

Your old saves will not be affected and you can now take your save to other devices![/h2]
